pages.quiz:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who is a coach? (1 mark)
   A. A person who trains a team
   B. The team's fans
   C. The person who blows the whistle
   D. The person who sells kit

2. Which word has the vowel /e/? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. bed
   C. late
   D. pain

3. Which question is factual? (1 mark)
   A. What lesson does the story teach?
   B. Who told Baraka about how HIV spreads?
   C. How did Omondi feel deep inside?
   D. Why do you think Baraka is brave?

4. What should your voice do at the end of a question when reading aloud? (1 mark)
   A. Rise
   B. Stop suddenly
   C. Stay flat
   D. Fall to a whisper

5. Why should you use a mobile phone only with permission? (1 mark)
   A. Phones are only for adults to own
   B. It makes the battery last longer
   C. It keeps you safe and responsible
   D. It makes calls cheaper

6. Poems and similes: Which sentence has a simile? (1 mark)
   A. The runner won the race.
   B. The runner was tired.
   C. The runner was as fast as a cheetah.
   D. The race started at nine.

7. What does 'sanitation' mean? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of food
   B. A game
   C. A type of shoe
   D. Clean toilets, drains and waste systems that protect health

8. Which answer suits 'Do you sweep every day?' (1 mark)
   A. It is mine.
   B. Yes, I do.
   C. In the compound.
   D. At six o'clock.

9. To make the /l/ sound, the tip of the tongue (1 mark)
   A. touches the top lip
   B. touches the bottom lip
   C. touches the ridge behind the top front teeth
   D. stays far from the roof of the mouth and curls back

10. Which word makes a request polite? (1 mark)
   A. hurry
   B. quick
   C. now
   D. please

11. What is a good habit for a listener? (1 mark)
   A. Look at the speaker and do not interrupt
   B. Talk while others speak
   C. Look away
   D. Play with things

12. A high, rising voice when we say 'Really?' shows (1 mark)
   A. surprise
   B. sleep
   C. boredom
   D. anger only

13. Which syllable is stressed in 'com-POUND'? (1 mark)
   A. The second
   B. Both equally
   C. The first
   D. Neither

14. Which part of a narrative tells who, where and when? (1 mark)
   A. The beginning
   B. The title
   C. The middle
   D. The end

15. What is the first step in writing a composition? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a story
   B. Write the conclusion
   C. Plan your ideas
   D. Draw a picture only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write a narrative of about 60 words about a visit to a shop. Use one simile and two time words. (5 marks)

17. Explain three uses of the comma with an example for each. (5 marks)

18. State the difference between a factual question and an inferential question. (2 marks)

19. List three hygiene habits mentioned in the text. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A person who trains a team
   A coach trains players.

2. B — bed
   Bed has the short vowel /e/.

3. B — Who told Baraka about how HIV spreads?
   A factual question has its answer stated in the text.

4. A — Rise
   A question ends with a rising voice.

5. C — It keeps you safe and responsible
   A trusted adult can guide you.

6. C — The runner was as fast as a cheetah.
   It compares the runner with a cheetah using as ... as.

7. D — Clean toilets, drains and waste systems that protect health
   Sanitation protects health by keeping waste away.

8. B — Yes, I do.
   A yes/no question needs a yes or no answer.

9. C — touches the ridge behind the top front teeth
   For /l/ the tongue tip touches the ridge and air flows around the sides.

10. D — please
   Please turns an order into a polite request.

11. A — Look at the speaker and do not interrupt
   Good listeners give attention.

12. A — surprise
   A rising voice can show surprise.

13. A — The second
   The stress falls on 'pound'.

14. A — The beginning
   The beginning introduces characters, setting and time.

15. C — Plan your ideas
   A plan puts ideas in order first.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: A story of about 60 words with beginning, middle and end, one simile, two time words such as first and then, and correct punctuation.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for beginning, events, simile, time words, and punctuation.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: In lists: rice, beans and cabbage. After yes or no: Yes, I can. When addressing a person: Mama, come here. Also before but/so between sentences.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each use and example (max 5 including quality of examples).

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: A factual question has an answer stated in the text. An inferential question needs you to use clues and think.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap; boil drinking water; use a clean latrine; cover food; brush teeth; cut nails short.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
